rejected.reason: Piper voice MODEL_CARD marks its RHVoice dataset license unknown.

The Russian MODEL_CARD lists CC0 for the Russian dataset but also says it is fine-tuned from the U.S. English Lessac voice. Lessac materials use a manually approved research license; commercial/publishing rights of inherited voice weights are not established.

Previously rejected; not approved for this workflow. The recorded CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 terms require a case-specific check of the licensed object, generated-output rights and intended use. Donations alone do not determine NonCommercial status; ND restrictions on sharing adapted licensed material do not by themselves settle rights to every generated speech output. No permission to use this voice is granted by this record.
